text:
Call your pediatrician today — a fever that's held at 39.5°C for two days with increased sleepiness in an 18-month-old is exactly the kind of thing they want to hear about before you adjust or start any medication.

I can't give you a dose. Ibuprofen dosing for toddlers is weight-based, and getting it wrong in either direction matters — that's your doctor or nurse line's call, not mine.

If Mira seems hard to wake, is breathing fast, has a rash, or isn't making tears when she cries, go to urgent care or the ER now rather than waiting for a callback.
